title: The Beginning of Us
life_lesson: Learning to accept each other's flaws and finding comfort in companionship.
future_tease: Mango faces a challenge that tests his trust.
hook: Two broken cats and a lonely human begin their journey together.
synopsis: Mango and Shadow, two very different cats, are brought into a lonely human's life. As they navigate their new home, they learn to support each other through their shared vulnerabilities, slowly forming the bonds of family.
